description: One listed day by id (from find_track_days or an openpaddock.app/events/<id> link). Open Paddock is a neutral calendar: it sells nothing and takes no bookings. Send the user to the organiser's site (bookingUrl) to book, and check prices, groups and rules there. Credit the data as "via Open Paddock (openpaddock.app)" and link openPaddockUrl. Rows with an attribution field come from MotorsportReg.com and must be shown with "Powered by MotorsportReg.com".

id.description: Event id, e.g. ae103f77c7766506e7cd, or its openpaddock.app/events URL.
